description: Add a creator to your watchlist so you can ask later what they have posted since. Stores the handle only — nothing is fetched here, so there is no cost. Use catch_up_watchlist to see what changed. No cost to call.

note.description: Why you are watching them — shown back to you later.

platform.description: Platform. Defaults to tiktok, so SET IT whenever the user named a network — otherwise a question about X, LinkedIn or Reddit is silently answered with TikTok data, and an empty result looks like the account does not exist. Accepts what get_user_posts does: tiktok, instagram, youtube, douyin, xiaohongshu, twitter, bilibili, linkedin, reddit, weibo.

name: watch_creator
title: Watch Creator
